sections: a place where trains stop for passengers. Mia walks to the station by the river.
by train · /baɪ treɪn/ · phrase · Phrase · New
Using a train to travel. We go to the city by train.
To leave one train or bus and get on another. We change trains at City Station.
A system of tracks and trains used to carry people or goods. The railroad connects the two towns.
train driver · /treɪn ˈdraɪvər/ · phrase · Phrase · New
A person whose job is to operate a train. The train driver opens the doors.

articulation.label: train
articulation.alt: train: /t/ → /r/ → /eɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
